subject.title: Redesign Overview as an operator-first OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should this PR become the canonical operator-first Overview dashboard, should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77774 own that redesign, or should both be narrowed before either lands?
rationale: Both open PRs redesign the same Control UI Overview surface, and automation cannot choose the product direction or reconcile the conflicting branches safely.

options.title: Repair And Decide Canonical
options.body: Keep this PR open while the contributor fixes provider/proof blockers, then have maintainers choose whether it or the overlapping dashboard PR should carry the final Overview redesign.

options.title: Move Direction To The Other PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77774 as the canonical dashboard redesign and ask this PR to extract only non-overlapping provider-usage pieces.

options.title: Pause Both Redesigns
options.body: Hold both dashboard PRs until maintainers define the first-screen Overview information architecture and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Repair And Decide Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open while the contributor fixes provider/proof blockers, then have maintainers choose whether it or the overlapping dashboard PR should carry the final Overview redesign.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the overlapping maintainer-labeled dashboard PR and has recent history on the Overview/provider quota surface.
